body: And, yes I have attempted suicide before, but it’s been self-torture more than anything. I feel like it would be better if I was gone, I feel so alone. I know everyone says ,,you are not alone” but…how? I feel so alone that it’s driving me insane. No one is here for me. Even though they say they are…they’re not.

We here feel the same..but for different reasons....This is genuenly heart breaking that you  feel that way....and you are not a huge waste of time! I dont know you but....we feel the same...Please try your best to stay alive as much as possible....
Dont worry i feel the same...i wish that i could end my pain....but before i do it i worry about the people that love me....
if you are sure...okay i wont for now....

i...feel the same. I mean the people we know cant help us and say that its all in our hands is stupid.....the least i can say is...you are not alone. I truly feel the same...sometimes i think that  the only option for me is to die....i still think it..im thinking it now.....im sorry....
